title: SSN structural validation vectors
description: Deterministic fixture of SSN candidates paired with SSA structural rejection reasons. Mirrors the rules in Swift SSNStructuralValidator and is consumed by downstream tests.

version.description: Schema version. Bump when the format changes in a way that requires a Swift-side decoder update.

generated_by.description: Identifier of the builder that produced this artifact.

seed.description: PRNG seed used to generate this artifact, recorded for reproducibility.

vectors.description: Test vectors. Each record is one SSN candidate with its expected structural verdict.

ssn.description: SSN candidate in AAA-GG-SSSS format. Always nine digits with two hyphens; rejection is content-based, not format-based.

valid.description: Whether the candidate passes every SSA structural rule.

rejection_reason.description: Which SSA rule rejects this SSN, or null if the SSN is valid. Mirrors Swift SSNStructuralValidator categories.
